steps/glorious-1-01.mp3: At sunrise the women bring spices to the tomb
steps/glorious-1-02.mp3: They wonder who will roll away the stone; it is already rolled back
steps/glorious-1-03.mp3: The angel says: do not be afraid; he is not here, he has been raised
steps/glorious-1-04.mp3: Why do you look for the living among the dead?
steps/glorious-1-05.mp3: Peter and the other disciple see the linen wrappings and believe
steps/glorious-1-06.mp3: Jesus calls Mary Magdalene by name and she knows him
steps/glorious-1-07.mp3: At Emmaus he is known to them in the breaking of the bread
steps/glorious-1-08.mp3: Thomas touches his wounds: my Lord and my God
steps/glorious-1-09.mp3: Blessid are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe
steps/glorious-1-10.mp3: Christ has been raised, the first fruits of those who have died
steps/glorious-2-01.mp3: I go to prepare a place for you
steps/glorious-2-02.mp3: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me
steps/glorious-2-03.mp3: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptising them
steps/glorious-2-04.mp3: I am with you always, to the end of the age
steps/glorious-2-05.mp3: Proclaim the good news to the whole creation
steps/glorious-2-06.mp3: You will receive power and be my witnesses to the ends of the earth
steps/glorious-2-07.mp3: He blesses them and is carried up into heaven
steps/glorious-2-08.mp3: He is lifted up and a cloud takes him out of their sight
steps/glorious-2-09.mp3: Two men in white ask why they stand looking up towards heaven
steps/glorious-2-10.mp3: They return to Jerusalem with great joy, blessing God
steps/glorious-3-01.mp3: The Father will give another Advocate, the Spirit of truth
steps/glorious-3-02.mp3: The Holy Spirit will teach you everything
steps/glorious-3-03.mp3: They devote themselves to prayer, together with Mary the mother of Jesus
steps/glorious-3-04.mp3: On the day of Pentecost they are all together in one place
steps/glorious-3-05.mp3: A sound like the rush of a violent wind fills the house
steps/glorious-3-06.mp3: Divided tongues, as of fire, rest on each of them
steps/glorious-3-07.mp3: All are filled with the Holy Spirit and speak in other languages
steps/glorious-3-08.mp3: People from every nation each hear them in their own language
steps/glorious-3-09.mp3: Repent and be baptised, and receive the gift of the Holy Spirit
steps/glorious-3-10.mp3: About three thousand people are baptised that day
steps/glorious-4-01.mp3: God puts enmity between the serpent and the woman
steps/glorious-4-02.mp3: You do not let your faithful one see the Pit
steps/glorious-4-03.mp3: Rise up, O Lord, to your resting place, you and the ark of your might
steps/glorious-4-04.mp3: Arise, my love, and come away; the winter is past
steps/glorious-4-05.mp3: From now on all generations will call me blessid
steps/glorious-4-06.mp3: The Mighty One has done great things for me
steps/glorious-4-07.mp3: In Christ all will be made alive
steps/glorious-4-08.mp3: Each in their own order: Christ, then those who belong to him
steps/glorious-4-09.mp3: Death has been swallowed up in victory
steps/glorious-4-10.mp3: God's temple in heaven opens and the ark of his covenant is seen
steps/glorious-5-01.mp3: King Solomon has a throne brought for his mother at his right hand
steps/glorious-5-02.mp3: At your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir
steps/glorious-5-03.mp3: Blessid are you by the Most High God above all women on earth
steps/glorious-5-04.mp3: You are the glory of Jerusalem and the great boast of Israel
steps/glorious-5-05.mp3: A woman clothed with the sun, with a crown of twelve stars
steps/glorious-5-06.mp3: The crown of righteousness is reserved for those who keep the faith
steps/glorious-5-07.mp3: Those who endure will receive the crown of life
steps/glorious-5-08.mp3: You will win the crown of glory that never fades away
steps/glorious-5-09.mp3: Be faithful until death and I will give you the crown of life
steps/glorious-5-10.mp3: The servants of God will reign for ever and ever
steps/joyful-1-01.mp3: The Lord himself will give a sign: a young woman will bear a son, Emmanuel
steps/joyful-1-02.mp3: The angel Gabriel is sent to a virgin named Mary in Nazareth
steps/joyful-1-03.mp3: Gabriel greets Mary as full of grace: the Lord is with her
steps/joyful-1-04.mp3: Mary is troubled, but the angel tells her not to be afraid
steps/joyful-1-05.mp3: She will conceive and bear a son and name him Jesus
steps/joyful-1-06.mp3: He will be called Son of the Most High and his kingdom will never end
steps/joyful-1-07.mp3: Mary asks how; the Holy Spirit will come upon her
steps/joyful-1-08.mp3: Elizabeth has conceived; nothing is impossible with God
steps/joyful-1-09.mp3: Mary answers: here am I, the servant of the Lord
steps/joyful-1-10.mp3: The Word became flesh and lived among us
steps/joyful-2-01.mp3: Mary sets out in haste to the hill country to visit Elizabeth
steps/joyful-2-02.mp3: The child leaps in Elizabeth's womb and she is filled with the Holy Spirit
steps/joyful-2-03.mp3: Elizabeth calls Mary blessid among women, and blessid is the fruit of her womb
steps/joyful-2-04.mp3: Why has the mother of my Lord come to me?
steps/joyful-2-05.mp3: The child in her womb leapt for joy at Mary's greeting
steps/joyful-2-06.mp3: Blessid is she who believed the Lord's promise
steps/joyful-2-07.mp3: Mary's song: her soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord
steps/joyful-2-08.mp3: The Mighty One has done great things; his mercy lasts for ever
steps/joyful-2-09.mp3: He scatters the proud, lifts up the lowly and fills the hungry
steps/joyful-2-10.mp3: Mary stays with Elizabeth about three months
steps/joyful-3-01.mp3: From little Bethlehem will come a ruler for Israel
steps/joyful-3-02.mp3: Emperor Augustus orders a census of the whole world
steps/joyful-3-03.mp3: Joseph goes with Mary to Bethlehem, the city of David
steps/joyful-3-04.mp3: Mary gives birth and lays her son in a manger: no room at the inn
steps/joyful-3-05.mp3: An angel appears to shepherds keeping watch at night
steps/joyful-3-06.mp3: Good news of great joy: a Saviour is born, the Messiah, the Lord
steps/joyful-3-07.mp3: The sign: a child wrapped in bands of cloth, lying in a manger
steps/joyful-3-08.mp3: The heavenly host sings: glory to God and peace on earth
steps/joyful-3-09.mp3: The shepherds hurry and find Mary, Joseph and the child
steps/joyful-3-10.mp3: The magi see the star, worship the child and offer gold, frankincense and myrrh
steps/joyful-4-01.mp3: Mary and Joseph bring Jesus to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
steps/joyful-4-02.mp3: Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord
steps/joyful-4-03.mp3: They offer a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons
steps/joyful-4-04.mp3: Simeon, righteous and devout, waits for the consolation of Israel
steps/joyful-4-05.mp3: The Spirit had promised Simeon he would see the Messiah
steps/joyful-4-06.mp3: Simeon takes the child in his arms: now let your servant go in peace
steps/joyful-4-07.mp3: A light for revelation to the Gentiles and glory for Israel
steps/joyful-4-08.mp3: This child is destined for the falling and rising of many
steps/joyful-4-09.mp3: A sword will pierce Mary's own soul too
steps/joyful-4-10.mp3: The prophet Anna praises God and speaks about the child
steps/joyful-5-01.mp3: Each year the family goes to Jerusalem for Passover; Jesus is twelve
steps/joyful-5-02.mp3: The boy Jesus stays behind without his parents knowing
steps/joyful-5-03.mp3: They search among relatives, then return to Jerusalem
steps/joyful-5-04.mp3: After three days they find him in the temple among the teachers
steps/joyful-5-05.mp3: All who hear him are amazed at his understanding
steps/joyful-5-06.mp3: Mary says: your father and I have been searching for you in great anxiety
steps/joyful-5-07.mp3: Did you not know I must be in my Father's house?
steps/joyful-5-08.mp3: They do not understand what he says to them
steps/joyful-5-09.mp3: He goes home obedient to them; Mary treasures all these things
steps/joyful-5-10.mp3: Jesus grows in wisdom and in years, and in favour with God and people
steps/luminous-1-01.mp3: John the Baptist preaches in the wilderness: repent
steps/luminous-1-02.mp3: People from all Judea are baptised by John in the Jordan
steps/luminous-1-03.mp3: One more powerful than John is coming after him
steps/luminous-1-04.mp3: He will baptise with the Holy Spirit and fire
steps/luminous-1-05.mp3: John sees Jesus coming: here is the Lamb of God
steps/luminous-1-06.mp3: Jesus comes to be baptised; John feels unworthy
steps/luminous-1-07.mp3: Jesus says it is right to fulfil all righteousness
steps/luminous-1-08.mp3: The heavens open and the Spirit descends like a dove
steps/luminous-1-09.mp3: A voice from heaven: this is my Son, the Beloved
steps/luminous-1-10.mp3: John testifies that Jesus is the Son of God
steps/luminous-2-01.mp3: There is a wedding at Cana; Mary, Jesus and his disciples are there
steps/luminous-2-02.mp3: The wine runs out and Mary tells Jesus: they have no wine
steps/luminous-2-03.mp3: Jesus answers that his hour has not yet come
steps/luminous-2-04.mp3: Mary tells the servants: do whatever he tells you
steps/luminous-2-05.mp3: Six stone water jars stand there for purification
steps/luminous-2-06.mp3: Jesus says fill the jars with water; they fill them to the brim
steps/luminous-2-07.mp3: Draw some out and take it to the chief steward
steps/luminous-2-08.mp3: The steward tastes the water that has become wine
steps/luminous-2-09.mp3: You have kept the good wine until now
steps/luminous-2-10.mp3: The first of his signs: his disciples believe in him
steps/luminous-3-01.mp3: The kingdom of God has come near: repent and believe the good news
steps/luminous-3-02.mp3: The Spirit of the Lord sends Jesus to bring good news to the poor
steps/luminous-3-03.mp3: Blessid are the poor in spirit: theirs is the kingdom of heaven
steps/luminous-3-04.mp3: Blessid are the merciful, the pure in heart and the peacemakers
steps/luminous-3-05.mp3: You are the light of the world: let your light shine
steps/luminous-3-06.mp3: Jesus teaches the Our Father: your kingdom come
steps/luminous-3-07.mp3: Strive first for the kingdom of God
steps/luminous-3-08.mp3: Jesus tells the paralysed man: your sins are forgiven
steps/luminous-3-09.mp3: Her many sins are forgiven, for she has shown great love
steps/luminous-3-10.mp3: Jesus sends the twelve to proclaim the kingdom and heal
steps/luminous-4-01.mp3: Jesus takes Peter, James and John up a high mountain
steps/luminous-4-02.mp3: While he is praying, the appearance of his face changes
steps/luminous-4-03.mp3: His face shines like the sun; his clothes become dazzling white
steps/luminous-4-04.mp3: Moses and Elijah appear, talking with him
steps/luminous-4-05.mp3: They speak of his departure, which he will accomplish in Jerusalem
steps/luminous-4-06.mp3: Peter says: Lord, it is good for us to be here
steps/luminous-4-07.mp3: A bright cloud and a voice: this is my Son, listen to him
steps/luminous-4-08.mp3: The disciples fall down in fear; Jesus touches them: do not be afraid
steps/luminous-4-09.mp3: Looking up, they see no one but Jesus himself alone
steps/luminous-4-10.mp3: Peter recalls being an eyewitness of his majesty on the holy mountain
steps/luminous-5-01.mp3: Having loved his own, Jesus loves them to the end
steps/luminous-5-02.mp3: Jesus has eagerly desired to eat this Passover with them
steps/luminous-5-03.mp3: He washes their feet and gives them an example
steps/luminous-5-04.mp3: He takes bread, blesses and breaks it: this is my body
steps/luminous-5-05.mp3: Do this in remembrance of me
steps/luminous-5-06.mp3: The cup of his blood of the covenant, poured out for forgiveness
steps/luminous-5-07.mp3: I am the bread of life
steps/luminous-5-08.mp3: I am the living bread that came down from heaven
steps/luminous-5-09.mp3: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood abides in me
steps/luminous-5-10.mp3: We proclaim the Lord's death until he comes
steps/sorrowful-1-01.mp3: Jesus goes with his disciples to Gethsemane to pray
steps/sorrowful-1-02.mp3: His soul is deeply grieved; he asks them to stay awake with him
steps/sorrowful-1-03.mp3: Let this cup pass from me; yet not what I want, but what you want
steps/sorrowful-1-04.mp3: An angel from heaven appears and gives him strength
steps/sorrowful-1-05.mp3: In his anguish his sweat becomes like great drops of blood
steps/sorrowful-1-06.mp3: Could you not stay awake one hour? The spirit is willing, the flesh weak
steps/sorrowful-1-07.mp3: He prays again: your will be done
steps/sorrowful-1-08.mp3: The hour is at hand: get up, let us be going
steps/sorrowful-1-09.mp3: Judas arrives with a crowd and betrays him with a kiss
steps/sorrowful-1-10.mp3: All the disciples desert him and flee
steps/sorrowful-2-01.mp3: Jesus is bound and handed over to Pilate
steps/sorrowful-2-02.mp3: Pilate asks him: are you the King of the Jews?
steps/sorrowful-2-03.mp3: My kingdom is not from this world
steps/sorrowful-2-04.mp3: Jesus came to testify to the truth; Pilate asks what truth is
steps/sorrowful-2-05.mp3: Pilate offers to release Barabbas or Jesus
steps/sorrowful-2-06.mp3: The crowd shouts: let him be crucified
steps/sorrowful-2-07.mp3: To satisfy the crowd, Pilate has Jesus flogged
steps/sorrowful-2-08.mp3: The servant gives his back to those who strike him
steps/sorrowful-2-09.mp3: He was wounded for our sins; by his bruises we are healed
steps/sorrowful-2-10.mp3: Like a lamb led to the slaughter, he does not open his mouth
steps/sorrowful-3-01.mp3: The soldiers gather the whole cohort around Jesus
steps/sorrowful-3-02.mp3: They strip him and put a scarlet robe on him
steps/sorrowful-3-03.mp3: They twist a crown of thorns, put a reed in his hand and mock him as king
steps/sorrowful-3-04.mp3: They spit on him and strike him on the head
steps/sorrowful-3-05.mp3: Pilate brings him out wearing the crown: here is the man
steps/sorrowful-3-06.mp3: The chief priests shout: crucify him
steps/sorrowful-3-07.mp3: Pilate would have no power unless it were given from above
steps/sorrowful-3-08.mp3: Here is your King; they answer that they have no king but Caesar
steps/sorrowful-3-09.mp3: Pilate washes his hands before the crowd
steps/sorrowful-3-10.mp3: He hands Jesus over to be crucified
steps/sorrowful-4-01.mp3: Carrying the cross by himself, Jesus goes out to the Place of the Skull
steps/sorrowful-4-02.mp3: Surely he has borne our infirmities and carried our diseases
steps/sorrowful-4-03.mp3: Simon of Cyrene is made to carry the cross
steps/sorrowful-4-04.mp3: A great crowd follows, including women mourning for him
steps/sorrowful-4-05.mp3: Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me
steps/sorrowful-4-06.mp3: If they do this when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry?
steps/sorrowful-4-07.mp3: Two criminals are led away to be put to death with him
steps/sorrowful-4-08.mp3: Whoever wants to follow me must take up their cross
steps/sorrowful-4-09.mp3: Christ suffered for you, leaving an example to follow in his steps
steps/sorrowful-4-10.mp3: For the joy set before him he endured the cross
steps/sorrowful-5-01.mp3: At the Skull they crucify Jesus between two criminals
steps/sorrowful-5-02.mp3: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing
steps/sorrowful-5-03.mp3: Today you will be with me in Paradise
steps/sorrowful-5-04.mp3: Standing near the cross is his mother
steps/sorrowful-5-05.mp3: Woman, here is your son; here is your mother
steps/sorrowful-5-06.mp3: Darkness comes over the whole land until three in the afternoon
steps/sorrowful-5-07.mp3: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
steps/sorrowful-5-08.mp3: I am thirsty ... It is finished
steps/sorrowful-5-09.mp3: Father, into your hands I commend my spirit
steps/sorrowful-5-10.mp3: The centurion says: truly this man was God's Son
